svg.title: What runs where
svg.desc: Slack talks to your signed-in Slack tab in Chrome or Brave, where the Misha Browser extension hears new messages and posts for Misha. On your Mac, the tab connects to the Misha app, which keeps your settings and records and holds what waits for your OK on Home. The app gives messages to the clone, your own Claude Code or OpenCode, which can start workers for work you allow. Outside your Mac, under your own accounts, the clone and the workers talk to your model provider, GitHub and the services you connect.
